description: Na₂UO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbam space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.68 Å. U⁶⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form edge-sharing UO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (1.93 Å) and four longer (2.18 Å) U-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one U⁶⁺ atom. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent U⁶⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃U₂ trigonal bipyramids.
